PB29-007.name: ［Blue Star Coord］Kiriya Aoi
PB29-007.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Turn)
Once per step, when your [STAR ANIS] Spirit is summoned, draw a card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks/Blocks)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack/block.

PB29-009.name: ［Candy House Coord］Kurisu Kokone
PB29-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
The effects of all “World”/“Sekai” Nexuses you or the opponent controls can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 4 or less “Idol” family Spirit card from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost. When this effect summons “Fujiwara Miyabi”, draw a card.

PB29-004.name: ［Green Star Coord］Toudou Yurika
PB29-004.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Besides "Toudou Yurika", you can return a [STAR ANIS] Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand. When you've done so, send three cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
If your Life is five or less, besides [Soul Core], send a core from your Trash to your Life.

PB29-010.name: ［Hagoromo Princess Coord］Fujiwara Miyabi
PB29-010.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 4 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
You can summon a Cost 4 or less “Idol” family Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Besides “Fujiwara Miyabi”, refresh an “Idol” family Spirit you control. When this effect refreshes “Kurisu Kokone”, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

PB29-002.name: ［Lime Star Coord］Kitaouji Sakura
PB29-002.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning a [STAR ANIS] Spirit card, fulfill one of its reduction symbols.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Once per turn, when your [STAR ANIS] Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, they can remain on the Field, exhausted.

PB29-006.name: ［Pink Star Coord］Hoshimiya Ichigo
PB29-006.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] (When Set)
Return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's an "Idol" family card, this Spirit refreshes. Also, if that card has [STAR ANIS], send an opposing Life to the Reserve. Add the revealed card to the Hand.

PB29-005.name: ［Purple Star Coord］Shibuki Ran
PB29-005.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can refresh a [STAR ANIS] Spirit you control.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -6000 BP. Activate this effect a number of times equal to the number of [STAR ANIS] Spirits you control, and destroy when BPs are brought to 0.

PB29-003.name: ［Orange Star Coord］Ichinose Kaede
PB29-003.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your [STAR ANIS] Spirit is summoned by an effect, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can return an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit to the deckbottom. When you've done so, draw a card.

PB29-008.name: ［Red Star Coord］Kanzaki Mizuki
PB29-008.effect:
Flash - [Advent: [STAR ANIS]] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[team: STAR ANIS]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents)
You can summon one of this Spirit's "Idol" family pre-advent cards, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3]
Every Cost 6 "Idol" family you control gains an extra Yellow symbol.

PB29-001.name: ［Yellow Star Coord］Arisugawa Otome
PB29-001.effect:
[team: STAR ANIS]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon a Cost 6 or less [STAR ANIS] Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can pay two costs to summon a [STAR ANIS] Spirit card from your Hand.
